stem: Which of these best demonstrates the moment when Traft Martin realizes he will lose the hearing?

options.label: F
options.text: "See!" Traft closed his eyes to do the math. "That makes her sixteen. Nowhere near old enough."

options.label: G
options.text: He turned on his heel and slammed out the door.

options.label: H
options.text: Traft jumped up. It looked as if he’d figured out where Mr. Ebgard was going too.

options.label: J
options.text: Traft shifted in his chair and smirked at me.
